about_the_game:
Story:

You are part of the Golden City guard when one day the King calls upon you to meet with him. Once you gather your troop up, you go and meet with the King in the Throne room only to learn that the King is requesting that your troop take on the mission to destroy a Demon that has awoken in the Forest Ruins north of the city. You, of course agree to take on such a mighty quest but also request to research the Demon. The King grants you this but tells you to not take too long as he doesn't know how long it will be before the Demon tries to overtake the city. 

You depart and begin to research the Demon. What path will you take as you learn the truth of the 'Golden Castle' and the city that surrounds it? How will you confront the Demon? 

Features:

  • Turn Based Combat

  • Discoverable Lore

  • Save Points as in Crystals that are found in the game

  • There is no Saving in the Menu

  • 4 Party members including yourself

  • 2 different endings

  • Level 40 Cap

  • Enemies that grow in level with you
